value.rationale: The exact viability cutoff distinguishes survival and loss of all-positive coexistence as mixing changes. In high-average-infectivity regimes all finite migration permits coexistence, but the compositional spectral gap collapses with an exact inverse-migration coefficient; this nontrivial timescale complements, rather than merely restates, endemic equilibrium positivity or known spatial segregation.
